Bug_Details:
This call doesn't make sense. For any collection c, calling c.containsAll(c) should
always be true, and c.retainAll(c) should have no effect.
     c c.containsAll(c) c.retainAll(c)
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates vacuous calls to collection methods by calling containsAll and retainAll on a collection with itself. Such calls are logically redundant and have no effect, as a collection always contains all its elements and retaining itself does not change anything.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases attempt to validate the logical outcome of vacuous calls by asserting incorrect results. The testContainsAllBug expects false from showBugContainsAll, which will always return true, thus failing and triggering the bug. Similarly, the testRetainAllBug expects true from showBugRetainAll, which will always return false, thus failing and triggering the bug.
